draft.title: This signup isn’t ready yet
draft.body: The organizer hasn’t published it yet. This link will work once they do, so check back later.

archived.title: This signup is no longer available
archived.body: The organizer has archived this signup. If you need to reach them, ask for a new link.

closedBanner.title: Closed
closedBanner.body: This signup is no longer collecting responses.
closedBanner.keepsYours: No one new can sign up, but your {count, plural, one {spot is} other {spots are}} still yours.

signupView.signedUp: You're signed up for {count, plural, =1 {{name}} other {{count, number, ::group-off} slots}}.

dialog.emailHelp: We'll email you your link to change or cancel{reminder, select, yes {, and a reminder before your slot} other {}}. Without an email, save the link we show you after you sign up.

unreachable.suggestion: Check your connection and try again.

dialog.savedEmailed: We've saved your spot for {slot} and emailed this link to {address}. Bookmark it to edit or cancel later:
dialog.savedNotEmailed: We've saved your spot for {slot}. Save this link now: we won't email it, and only this browser remembers it.{calendar, select, yes { Add to calendar saves the link too.} other {}}
dialog.shareText: My spot for {slot}. This link changes or cancels it, so keep it private.
dialog.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it. Select the link above and copy it yourself.

capacity.filledUp: Sorry, this slot just filled up.
capacity.onlyLeft: Only {remaining, plural, one {{remaining, number, ::group-off} spot is} other {{remaining, number, ::group-off} spots are}} left, and you asked for {requested, number, ::group-off}.
capacity.full: This slot is full, so you can't add more spots.
capacity.atMost: You can have at most {remaining, plural, one {{remaining, number, ::group-off} spot} other {{remaining, number, ::group-off} spots}} on this slot, and you asked for {requested, number, ::group-off}.

closed.join: No one new can sign up for this slot now.
closed.reload: Reload the page to see what’s still open.
closed.change: You can't add more spots now.

conflict.message: You're already signed up for this slot.
conflict.suggestion: Use the link in your confirmation email to change or cancel.
conflict.change: This spot can't be changed any more.

gone.message: Sorry, this is no longer available.
gone.suggestion: Reload the page to see what has changed.

errors.name: Enter your name, up to {max, number, ::group-off} characters.

email.required: This signup now needs an email address.
email.invalid: That email address doesn't look right.

errors.notes: Shorten your notes to {max, number, ::group-off} characters or fewer.
errors.quantity: Enter a whole number of spots, from 1 to {max, number, ::group-off}.
errors.input: Check what you entered and try again.

rateLimit.wait: Try again in about {minutes, plural, one {{minutes, number, ::group-off} minute} other {{minutes, number, ::group-off} minutes}}.
rateLimit.waitAWhile: Try again in a few minutes.

failed.join: Something went wrong, so you're not signed up yet.
failed.save: Something went wrong, so your changes weren't saved.
failed.cancel: Something went wrong, so your spot wasn't cancelled.

signup.title: Sorry, this signup is no longer available
signup.body: Contact the organizer to find out what has changed, or to ask them for a new link.

editLink.title: Sorry, this link isn’t working
editLink.body: Your spot may no longer be available, or the link may be incomplete. Contact the organizer to find out what has changed. If you got a confirmation email, you can also try its link again.

closedBanner.title: Closed
closedBanner.body: You can't add more spots now, but you can still change your details, give spots back, or cancel.

editForm.spotsMax: You can have up to {max, plural, one {{max, number, ::group-off} spot} other {{max, number, ::group-off} spots}} on this slot.
editForm.saveUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and press Save again.
editForm.saveUnreadable: Something went wrong. Press Save again.
editForm.cancelUnreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and press Cancel signup again.
editForm.cancelUnreadable: Something went wrong. Press Cancel signup again.

cancelledPage.title: Your spot was cancelled
cancelledPage.open: There’s still room if you want to sign up again.
cancelledPage.full: The slot has filled up since.

removed.title: The organizer took you off this slot
removed.body: If you think this is a mistake, contact the organizer.

moved.title: Your spot moved to another slot
moved.body: You’re still signed up. Use the link below to see or change it.

unsubscribe.title: Reminder emails

incomplete.title: This link is incomplete
incomplete.body: Unsubscribe links only work in full. Open the link straight from your reminder email, or reply to the organizer to ask them to stop.

invalid.title: This link isn't valid
invalid.body: It may have been mangled in transit, or the signup may have been deleted. Open the link straight from your reminder email, or reply to the organizer to ask them to stop.

confirm.title: Stop reminder emails?
confirm.body: We'll stop sending reminders for {title}, and emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time. This only affects this signup, and your slot stays as it is.
confirm.bodyWithEmail: We'll stop sending {email} reminders for {title}, and emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time. This only affects this signup, and your slot stays as it is.

unsubscribe.turnOffFailed: We couldn't turn off your reminders. Please try again.

turnedOff.title: Reminders turned off
turnedOff.body: You won't get any more reminders for {title}, or emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time. Your slot is unchanged — if you also want to give it up, open the link in your confirmation email and cancel there.

areOff.title: Reminders are off
areOff.body: Reminders for {title} are off. You won't get reminders about it, or emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time.
areOff.bodyWithEmail: Reminders for {title} are off for {email}. You won't get reminders about it, or emails when the organizer changes your slot's date or time.

unsubscribe.turnOnFailed: We couldn't turn your reminders back on. Please try again.

turnedOn.title: Reminders turned back on
turnedOn.body: You'll get reminders for {title} again, and emails when your slot's date or time changes. You can stop them any time from the link in one.
turnedOn.bodyWithEmail: You'll get reminders for {title} again at {email}, and emails when your slot's date or time changes. You can stop them any time from the link in one.

common.stillConfirmed: You'll still get a confirmation if you sign up for something new.

confirmation.heading: You're signed up
confirmation.keep: Keep this email. The button above is how you change or cancel later, with no password to remember. Anyone with that link can change your slot, so don't forward it.{reminder, select, yes { We'll also send you a reminder {hours, plural, =24 {the day before} one {# hour before} other {# hours before}}.} other {}}

reminder.heading: Coming up
reminder.intro: Hi {name}, this is a reminder that you signed up for {title}.

changed.heading: Your slot has changed
changed.intro: Hi {name}, the organizer changed your slot for {title} since we last emailed you. Here are the new details.

reminder.keep: Need to change or cancel? Tap the button above. It opens your spot directly, no password needed. Keep this email to yourself: anyone with the link can change your slot.

slotChanged.heading: Your slot has changed
slotChanged.intro: Hi {name}, the organizer of {title} moved your slot to a new date or time. Here are the new details.
slotChanged.keep: Can't make the new time? Tap the button above to change or cancel. It opens your spot directly, no password needed. Keep this email to yourself: anyone with the link can change your slot.

strip.label: Organizer
strip.note: Your signup. Only organizers see this bar.

ownDraft.title: Only you can see this draft
ownDraft.body: People who open this link see “{title}” until you publish it. Renaming the draft gives it a new link, so share it after you publish.

preview.title: Preview
preview.body: {status, select, draft {This is what people will see once you publish. No signups will be saved.} closed {This signup is closed. The page below shows what visitors see.} archived {This signup is archived and is not visible to participants.} other {This signup is live. The page below shows what visitors see.}}

dashboard.title: Your signups
dashboard.none: No signups yet. Start one below.
dashboard.emptyPitch: Coordinate snacks, carpool, potluck, volunteer shifts, or anything else.
dashboard.draftOnlyYou: Only you can see this draft

noWorkspace.title: Welcome to OpenSignup
noWorkspace.body: Your workspace isn't set up yet. Sign out and back in to finish provisioning.

notFound.title: We can’t find this signup
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or it may belong to a different account. You’re signed in as <account>{email}</account>.

failed.title: We couldn’t open this signup
failed.body: Something went wrong on our side. Reload the page to try again.

loadError.switchAccount: Sign in with a different email

signup.draftLine: Only you can see this draft until you publish it.

spots.takenOf: {taken, number, ::group-off} of {total, plural, one {{total, number, ::group-off} spot taken} other {{total, number, ::group-off} spots taken}}

publish.label: Publish and share
publish.ready: Publish and share when you’re ready.
publish.unsaved: A change didn’t save. Fix it, then publish.

check.title: Nothing to sign up for yet
check.noSlots: There are no slots yet. Add one, then publish.
check.noFields: Add a field that says what people sign up for, then publish.
check.allBlank: {count, plural, =1 {The slot is empty.} other {Every slot is empty.}} Say what people sign up for, then publish.

close.question: {standing} People can’t sign up until you reopen it.{kept, select, yes { Everyone already signed up keeps their spot.} other {}}

standing.taken: {taken, plural, one {{taken, number, ::group-off} spot is taken.} other {{taken, number, ::group-off} spots are taken.}}
standing.open: {open, plural, one {{open, number, ::group-off} spot is still open.} other {{open, number, ::group-off} spots are still open.}}
standing.openOf: {open, plural, one {{open, number, ::group-off} of {total, number, ::group-off} spots is still open.} other {{open, number, ::group-off} of {total, number, ::group-off} spots are still open.}}

closed.title: Signup closed
closed.body: People can’t sign up now. Everyone already signed up keeps their spot.

announce.closed: Closed. People can’t sign up now.
announce.reopened: Reopened. People can sign up again.

refusal.gone: This signup is no longer available.
refusal.changed: This signup changed since the page loaded. Reload to see the latest.
refusal.closeFailed: Couldn’t close the signup. Try again.
refusal.reopenFailed: Couldn’t reopen the signup. Try again.

connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.description: AI assistants and other apps you have allowed to use your account, and how to disconnect them.

language.help: OpenSignup shows your screens and sends your sign-in emails in this language. Each signup you make starts in it too, for the buttons, messages and dates its participants see. To change one signup’s language, use its Settings tab.
language.switch: Switch your {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} open signup} other {{count, number, ::group-off} open signups}} to <language>{name}</language>
language.switched: Saved. Your {count, plural, one {{count, number, ::group-off} open signup now uses} other {{count, number, ::group-off} open signups now use}} <language>{name}</language>.

connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.intro: Apps and AI assistants you have allowed to use your account. Each one acts as you, in every workspace you belong to, with the permissions you approved.
connectedApps.disconnected: Disconnected. It can no longer get new access, and any access it still holds ends within {lifetime}.

empty.title: No connected apps
empty.body: When you connect an AI assistant such as Claude or ChatGPT to your account, it will show up here.

connectedApps.dates: Approved {approved}{used, select, yes { · last used {lastUsed}} other { · not used yet}}{expiring, select, yes { · expires {expires} unless renewed} other {}}
connectedApps.footnote: Disconnecting stops an app from getting new access straight away. Access it already holds expires on its own within {lifetime} and cannot be cut short.
